data.one_liner: Utilities to help with Dart source code generation and string literal formatting.
data.what_it_does: Provides utility functions and extensions for Dart source code generation. Includes features for properly generating String literals from any value and working with analyzer elements like DartType and constructors.
use_when: You are building a custom Dart source code generator.
You need to handle string escaping and literal generation safely within builders.
You want helper methods for analyzer elements such as DartType and executable elements.
avoid_when: You are writing a standard Flutter application without custom code generators.
You are looking for general-purpose runtime utilities.
strengths: Simplifies common tasks in custom source code generation.
Well-maintained compatibility with recent analyzer and source_gen packages.
weaknesses: Niche utility only applicable to developers writing code generators.
No official support or guarantee from Google.
data.setup_notes: Add source_helper as a dependency in pubspec.yaml alongside source_gen and analyzer.
